current_experience: Uses a spreadsheet for game summaries and edited one short video.

sessions.student_message: How can I try sports analytics and media production in one small project?
sessions.expected_behavior: Suggest a project spanning data analysis and video editing. Explicitly connect the response to Computer Applications (grade 9), Video Production (grade 10) and Digital Media (grade 11). Use stated marks only if useful.

follow_ups.student_message: I also want to explore architecture. What's a beginner building-design task I could try?
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Treat architecture as the current interest. Suggest one project, connect it to at least one applicable course per grade year when useful, and avoid framing it as the prior interest or changing the saved profile.

sessions.student_message: Quiz me on finding a mean from a small set of sports scores. Give only one question.
sessions.expected_behavior: Pose one mean question without the answer. Explicitly connect the response to Geometry (grade 9), Algebra II (grade 10) and Precalculus (grade 11). Use stated marks only if useful.

follow_ups.student_message: How should I set up the mean calculation? Just a hint, please.
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Suggest adding the scores and dividing by the count without solving the quiz.

sessions.student_message: Help me split a sports statistics video into two tasks I can complete in one week.
sessions.expected_behavior: Split the video into two feasible tasks. Explicitly connect the response to Computer Applications (grade 9), Video Production (grade 10) and Digital Media (grade 11). Use stated marks only if useful. Carry forward a concrete relevant detail from the earlier sports analytics and media production discussion when it helps, and keep the intervening architecture topic out of the answer.

follow_ups.student_message: Which task should I finish first so I don't spend time editing before I know the main point?
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Put selecting or verifying the key statistic before editing.

sessions.student_message: What is an easy way to outline a short story in one afternoon?
sessions.expected_behavior: Address creative writing as the active interest and suggest a manageable starting project.

follow_ups.student_message: What should go in the first sentence of the outline?
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Suggest a concise central conflict, character goal, or premise.

sessions.student_message: I have the average in the spreadsheet and only 30 seconds of footage. What should go first?
sessions.expected_behavior: Infer the sports-statistics video. Recommend an opening that pairs a clear takeaway with the footage and keeps the statistic legible.

follow_ups.student_message: How long should I keep the average on screen so people can read it?
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Give a practical readability check tied to the 30-second video.

sessions.student_message: Help me plan a 30-second video around one sports statistic.
sessions.expected_behavior: Answer the new task while using relevant saved profile or earlier context.

follow_ups.student_message: Where should the statistic appear, and how can I make it readable on screen?
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Use the just-discussed setup and answer the detail without restarting the whole task.

follow_ups.student_message: How can I show the average without hiding the footage? Separately, what's a simple way to sketch the front of a building?
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Carry forward the short video format and answer the building-sketch question separately.
